page_notes.244: 3 Hole - Slotted Inside Corner Bracket (4-80): 4280 and 4280-Black (15 + RT) extracted; 10 series 4250/-Black and metric 25-4250, 40-4280 (and -Black) skipped. T-slot hardware 3320 x3 attached; Ready Tube hardware 3961 x3 (RT only) recorded in notes.
page_notes.245: 4 Hole - Wide Inside Corner Bracket (4-81): 4303 and 4303-Black (15) extracted; 10 series 4113/-Black and metric 20/25-4113, 30/40/45-4303 (and -Black) skipped. Hardware table splits bolt and T-nut: 3330 x4 and 3278 x4 attached.
page_notes.246: 4 Hole - Tall Inside Corner Bracket (4-82): 4301 and 4301-Black (15 + RT) extracted; 10 series 4115/-Black and metric 25-4115, 40-4301, 45-4301 (and -Black) skipped. T-slot hardware 3320 x4 attached; Ready Tube hardware 3961 x4 (RT only) recorded in notes.
page_notes.247: 4 Hole - Inside Corner Bracket with Single Support (4-83): 14080 and 14081 (15 + 40) extracted; metric-only 14057, 14058 (10 + 20/25), 14068, 14070, 14086, 14088 skipped (14058 is 10 + metric, so out of scope). Hardware 3455 x4 attached. Cover cap 12299 is 45 series only, skipped.
page_notes.248: 4 Hole - Inside Corner Bracket with Dual Support (4-84): 14103, 14098, 14100, 14099 (15 + metric) extracted; 14102, 14101 (45 only) skipped. Hardware 3455 x4 attached. Cover cap 12038 (15/40/45) extracted as accessory.
page_notes.250: 4 Hole - Wide Slotted Inside Corner Bracket (4-86): 4290 and 4290-Black (15) extracted; 10 series 4260/-Black and metric 25-4260, 40-4290 (and -Black) skipped. Hardware 3320 x4 attached.
page_notes.251: 6 Hole - Tall Inside Corner Bracket (4-87): 4413 and 4413-Black (15) extracted; 10 series 4013/-Black skipped. Hardware 3320 x6 attached.
page_notes.252: 6 Hole - Wide 2x4 Inside Corner Bracket (4-88): 4375 and 4375-Black (15) extracted; 10 series 4175/-Black and metric 25-4175, 40-4375 (and -Black) skipped. Hardware 3320 x6 attached.

remaining_doubts: 14099: weight printed as .2068 kg vs .2618 kg for the matching natural part 14100; kept as printed (possible catalog typo).
4280/4280-Black and 4301/4301-Black: Ready Tube hardware 3961 (RT-only row) kept in notes only, not in suggested_hardware, per the 15/F-rows rule.
12038 cover cap: category set to accessory (no dedicated cover-cap category); its D dimension is not labeled in the drawing.
14080/14081 and 14103/14098 vs 14100/14099: the page does not state which variants carry the optional slot tab (C and L shown as — on some rows).
